# Meelte

> Meelte is a hyper-local community and commerce platform for India. It connects residents with nearby food, fashion, events, services, health providers, neighborhood communities, and local job opportunities — without selling or sharing user location.

Meelte helps people discover what matters within their neighborhood, meet like-minded neighbors, create and host community gatherings, and find verified local jobs. Local merchants promote their products and services directly to nearby customers with 0% commission. Meelte is free for community members and available on the Google Play Store for Android.

- Official Website: https://meelte.com
- Contact: support@meelte.com
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada
- Coverage: India (active community hubs in Bengaluru, Gaya, and Ranchi)

---

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://meelte.com/): Platform overview, the Discover / Connect / Create / Grow pillars, 5 discovery categories, jobs spotlight, and Android app download.
- [About](https://meelte.com/about): Meelte's origin story, mission, and the local problems the platform was built to solve.
- [Grow with Meelte](https://meelte.com/merchant): Merchant and local business promotion with 0% commission and direct customer inquiries.
- [Local Jobs Board](https://meelte.com/jobs): Verified neighborhood job openings with direct applications and resume upload.
- [Contact](https://meelte.com/contact): Support, merchant onboarding, event partnerships, and recruitment inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://meelte.com/privacy): How Meelte handles location and personal data.
- [Terms of Service](https://meelte.com/terms): Platform terms and usage conditions.
- [Sitemap](https://meelte.com/sitemap): Human-readable directory of all public pages.

## Discovery Categories

- [Food](https://meelte.com/category/food): Local dining, artisan foods, homemade bakes, street food specialties, and neighborhood cafes.
- [Fashion](https://meelte.com/category/fashion): Local boutiques, apparel, regional designers, and handmade accessories.
- [Events](https://meelte.com/category/events): Community meetups, cultural festivals, workshops, and sports gatherings.
- [Services](https://meelte.com/category/services): Verified home services, repairs, tutors, and local professionals.
- [Health](https://meelte.com/category/health): Neighborhood clinics, fitness studios, and holistic wellness centers.

## Core Features

- [Discover](https://meelte.com/): Real-time hyper-local search across nearby products, dining, services, and events.
- [Connect](https://meelte.com/about): Find and meet neighbors who share your language, culture, interests, and goals.
- [Create](https://meelte.com/): Organize, publish, and host community events, interest clubs, and neighborhood gatherings.
- [Grow](https://meelte.com/merchant): Local businesses promote products and services to nearby customers with 0% commission.
- [Local Jobs Board](https://meelte.com/jobs): Local job listings where candidates apply with resume uploads and employers manage applications.
